output.reason: The EA-versus-RD comparison, together with the tier-level yield (the cut tiers fell and the unchanged tiers held), makes a strong case for the merit schedule over the portal, though the merit tiers were also the slowed files and the tier data isn't split by round, so some confounding remains.
